items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I worked with the Ellington Band then... Duke always sort of held me as an ace in the hole... all he had to do was call and I'd come over and do the job for him

ctx.x: All I knew was that he was a friend of Duke's. -- I met him with Duke. (inaudible).
You must have met him on his -- yes, well, he's passed, he's passed now. He was a friend of Duke's. But he was a very, very handsome man and --
